findings.quote: The microreactor was capped with a teflon pressure cap and placed into pre-heated aluminum block at 80 oC.
findings.message: The standalone HeatChill step does not identify what is heated and places block preheating after substrate addition, although its timing is unspecified. The subsequent HeatChill step already represents the reaction heating. Preserve block preheating and reactor placement as unmapped details rather than an ambiguous additional heating step.
The GC/MS completion check before solvent removal is omitted. It cannot be represented by an allowed operation and should be retained under unmapped_actions.

value.evidence: placed into pre-heated aluminum block at 80 oC
value.reason: Placement of the microreactor into the preheated block is not represented by an allowed operation. Block preheating is distinct from reaction heating; its timing and duration are unspecified.
Completion was checked by GC/MS before THF removal; analytical monitoring is not represented by an allowed operation.
